paper_title: ChARM Character-based Act-adaptive Reward Modeling for Advanced   Role-Playing Language Agents
caption_used: The character distribution in RoleplayPref is organized into three primary categories — Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters — with 13 subcategories in the outer ring. Virtual Characters occupy approximately 60% of the distribution and are subdivided into Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, with Movie Characters forming the largest virtual subcategory. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

The Virtual Characters category, depicted as a large central blue segment, occupies approximately 60% of the total distribution and is subdivided into five subcategories—Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters—all rendered in a light blue hue; among these, Movie Characters is visually the largest segment. The Real Characters category, shown as a smaller green segment adjacent to the central circle, comprises seven subcategories—Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers—each labeled with a green text label and presented as smaller, distinct segments; visually, Musicians is the largest segment within this group. The Custom Characters category is represented as a small pink segment adjacent to the Real Characters, with no further subcategories labeled. The diagram includes textual labels for all segments and does not display percentage values within the segments, though the relative sizes suggest approximate proportions. The segments are arranged radially around the center, with Virtual Characters forming the largest outer ring, followed by Real Characters, and Custom Characters appearing as the smallest segment.
model_annotations.English: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types within RoleplayPref, organized into three primary categories—Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters—with 13 subcategories shown in the outer ring. The largest segment, Virtual Characters, occupies approximately 60% of the chart and is subdivided into five subcategories: Comic Characters (light blue), Movie Characters (light blue), Teleplay Characters (light blue), Novel Characters (light blue), and Game Characters (light blue), with Movie Characters being the largest among them. Real Characters constitute a smaller portion, shown as a green segment divided into seven subcategories: Scientists (green), Artists (green), Athletes (green), Writers (green), Musicians (green), Actors (green), and Influencers (green), with Musicians being the largest within this group. Custom Characters form a small pink segment with no further subcategories labeled. The chart visually emphasizes the central “Virtual Characters” category by placing it in the middle, while the outer ring displays the 13 subcategories arranged in a circular fashion around it. There is no legend or percentage labels inside the slices, though the relative sizes suggest the proportions described in the caption.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Verteilung von Charakteren in RoleplayPref in drei Hauptkategorien – Virtual Characters, Custom Characters und Real Characters – mit insgesamt 13 Unterkategorien im äußeren Ring; Virtual Characters nehmen etwa 60 % der Verteilung ein und sind in Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters und Game Characters unterteilt, wobei Movie Characters der größte Teil der virtuellen Kategorie ist, Real Characters umfassen sieben Unterkategorien, darunter Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors und Influencers, wobei Musicians der größte Teil der realen Kategorie ist, und Custom Characters nehmen einen kleinen Anteil ein, ohne weitere Unterkategorien zu besitzen; das Diagramm ist als konzentrisches Kreisdiagramm gestaltet, wobei Virtual Characters als zentraler, blauer Kreis dargestellt sind, Real Characters als grüner Ring außen um den blauen Kreis und Custom Characters als roter Segment zwischen den beiden Ringen; die Unterkategorien sind als Sektoren im äußeren Ring angeordnet und jeweils mit einer Beschriftung versehen, wobei die Farben der Sektoren unterschiedlich sind, um die Kategorien zu unterscheiden; keine Prozentangaben sind innerhalb der Segmente angegeben, aber die relativen Größen der Segmente sind visuell erkennbar.
